title: Use the right side when the left is null

origin.description: NULL takes the right value. Anything else, including FALSE, stays.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: The value to keep unless it is null.

origin.details: None is NULL. False is not null, so it is kept.
origin.example:
bp_null_coalesce <- getFromNamespace("%||%", "backports")
print(bp_null_coalesce(NULL, FALSE))
print(bp_null_coalesce(FALSE, NULL))
